results.title: CMS Releases Final Rule for 2026 for Health Insurance Marketplaces, Aimed at Safeguarding Consumers, and Improving Transparency and Health Equity - Applied Policy
results.content: On January 13, 2025, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) issued the final Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2026 (CMS-9888-F) with a fact sheet. CMS also solicited and received public input on ways to reduce the risk of issuer insolvencies adversely impacting the integrity of Federally Facilitated Marketplace (FFMs) and address silver loading by plan issuers as well as input on how assisters in hospitals may refer consumers to programs designed to reduce medical debt. Note that **no policies were proposed or finalized in this rule to address the current copay accumulator policy** which is from the 2020 NBPP rule. A future proposed rule will be issued by HHS and the Departments of Labor and Treasury to address the applicability of drug manufacturer support to the annual limitation on cost-sharing.
